svg.title: Moving orders between the posts tables and HPOS with wp wc hpos
svg.desc: Two states are shown: posts authoritative, where orders live in wp_posts and wp_postmeta, and HPOS authoritative, where orders live in the wc_orders tables. The command wp wc hpos enable moves from posts to HPOS authoritative when the stores are in sync or the shop is new, and all active plugins are compatible; the flag with-sync also turns on compatibility mode. The command wp wc hpos disable moves back when no orders are pending sync. Two boxes below describe compatibility mode, which keeps both stores written, and wp wc hpos sync, which copies orders in batches from the authoritative store to the other one. A row of diagnostics lists status, count_unmigrated, verify_data, diff, backfill, cleanup and compatibility-info. The cleanup command removes redundant postmeta only when HPOS is authoritative and compatibility mode is off.
svg.text: wp wc hpos: two states, one switch, a set of checks
